name: Guile of the Raptor
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
With some additional objects, I will be able to create an item that will imbue Gor'mul with the guile of the raptor! With the power of the raptor flowing through him, Gor'mul will know our new power and rediscover the warrior that lies dormant!

I will require raptor hearts to fashion the item and spell.
narrative.objectives: Acquire 12 Raptor Hearts from Highland Fleshstalkers for Tor'gan.
narrative.offerRewardText: Yes, these will work perfectly. I will transfer their power and the spirit of the raptors into this orb. This orb will imbue Gor'mul with the fiery strength and intelligence of the raptor.
narrative.requestItemsText: My preparations are made, all I require are the raptor hearts.
